keyword.en: integrated mixer pump 45 kW and 14 kW
keyword.zh: 搅拌泵一体机45千瓦和14千瓦怎么分

h1.en: Reading the Integrated Mixer Splits Motor Power with a picture from Impeller
h1.zh: 读搅拌泵一体机怎样拆分电机功率，配图来自「葉輪」

directAnswer.en: The integrated mixer is a concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai with two motors on one line: main motor 45 kW and mixer motor 14 kW. Theoretical output is 21 m³/h, not 45 and not 59. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller.
directAnswer.zh: 搅拌泵一体机是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，一行里有两台电机：主电机 45 kW，搅拌电机 14 kW。理论输送量是 21 m³/h，不是 45，也不是 59。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller. Subject: Impeller. The integrated mixer is a concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai with two motors on one line: main motor 45 kW and mixer motor 14 kW. The page does not call it a second pumping motor, and it does not list a second output for mixing. 21 m³/h is the theoretical output. None of those entries is split into a main figure and a mixer figure.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller。画面主体：Impeller。搅拌泵一体机是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，一行里有两台电机：主电机 45 kW，搅拌电机 14 kW。这一格的标题是主电机/搅拌电机，数值是 45 kW / 14 kW。

body.en: Theoretical output is 21 m³/h, not 45 and not 59. The entry is labelled main motor / mixer motor and the value is 45 kW / 14 kW. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Electric 40 lists one motor, 45 kW, and output 21 m³/h, without a 14 kW mixer motor.
body.zh: 理论输送量是 21 m³/h，不是 45，也不是 59。把它们加成 59 kW 的泵送功率，不是河北品锦机械写出的内容。

body.en: Outlet pressure is 23 MPa and distance is 100 m / 300 m. Keep both numbers with their names. Pipe diameter is 100 / 125 mm. Similar output does not make it a mixer.
body.zh: 出口压力 23 MPa，距离 100 m / 300 m。电动40只标出一台电机 45 kW，产量 21 m³/h，没有 14 kW 搅拌电机。

body.en: The second motor is named as the mixer motor. Adding them into one 59 kW pumping figure is not what Hebei Pinjin Machinery shown. Aggregate is 4 cm and below. The mixer page is the one with two named motors.
body.zh: 页面没有把它叫做第二台泵送电机，也没有为搅拌单标出一个产量。

question.en: On this row: What is the 14 kW motor?

answer.en: The page names it the mixer motor. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller.
answer.zh: 页面把它命名为搅拌电机。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is output 45 m³/h?

answer.en: No. Output is 21 m³/h. 45 kW is the main motor. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller.
answer.zh: 不是。产量是 21 m³/h。45 kW 是主电机。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does the mixer motor have its own distance?
question.zh: 搅拌电机有自己的距离吗？

answer.en: No. Distance is shown once: 100 m / 300 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller.
answer.zh: 没有。距离只标出一次：100 m / 300 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is Electric 40 the same machine?

answer.en: No. Electric 40 does not list a 14 kW mixer motor. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller.
answer.zh: 不是。电动40没有标出 14 kW 搅拌电机。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeller画面里印出的数字。
